definition: סתו Kt , סְתָיו Qr noun masculine winter (loan-word from Aramaic; compare Syriac , ᵑ7 סִיתְוָא ; Arabic Lane 1504 ; probably originally ׳ שׂ , compare Schw Idioticon 64 ; on ו as old nominative ending ( ׳ ס for šutayu ) compare Lag BN 190 Anm .); — הַסְּתָ֯ו עָבָ֑ר Song 2:11 .
